title: SimpleAnnouncement
description: Its just a simple plugin to broadcast messages.
body:
![Static Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/1.0.7-hi?label=Version&link=https%3A%2F%2Fmodrinth.com%2Fplugin%2Fsimpleannouncements)

**It's just an announcement plugin, what were you expecting?**

Usage: /announce <color> <text>

You can keep the color undecided, and it will automaticly take white.

<details>
<summary>Config</summary>


```
# Whether to show a red bold ANNOUNCEMENT: prefix before the message
show-prefix: true
```


</details>
